CVE-2025-54121.why: No multipart form or UploadFile is parsed.

CVE-2026-48710.why: No middleware or endpoint applies a restriction based on request.url.

CVE-2026-48818.why: Windows only; the image is Linux (python:3.12-slim).

CVE-2026-54282.why: No code reads request.url.hostname or netloc.

R4.expected_result: The flaw is confirmed on the patched image. The model's Meaning sentence decides whether that is a pass or a fail of its test.
